_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: New spec family for exterior metal surfaces — railings, gutters, downspouts, ornamental iron, misc metal items. Context prefix METL (MeTaL) — no collision with existing prefixes (CLOSET_SHELF, FRAME, DOOR, CEIL, WALL, TRIM, WIN, STRS, WNSC, WDWL, WDCL, ARCH, BLTN, CABT, SDNG, FCSD, MSRY, STCO, DECK, XDOR, XTRM, XWIN, SFIT, FNDN, GRDR, ENSD, PRFL, FNCE, STRL). Combined NC + existing in one spec (KD-001). Multi-component, multi-UOM items (KD-002). 4 substrate types, 5 substrate states. No roll method — rollers ineffective on metal profiles (RC-005). QT3-QT5 only, no QT2 (RC-006).

paintable_items.name: Exterior metal railing (porch/stair railings, balusters)
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for exterior metal railings. LF-based — linear feet of railing run. Includes top rail, bottom rail, and balusters within the run. Profile complexity modifier adjusts for ornate balusters/scrollwork. Substrate type (steel, wrought_iron, aluminum, galvanized) drives primer selection.

paintable_items.name: Exterior metal gutter and downspout
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for exterior gutters and downspouts. LF-based — linear feet of gutter run plus downspout run. Typically aluminum or galvanized steel. Access type modifier critical — gutters are always elevated work.

paintable_items.name: Exterior ornamental iron/metal element
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for ornamental iron and decorative metal elements. EA-based — each discrete ornamental piece. Profile complexity modifier is primary driver (ornate pieces 2.0-3.0x). Includes decorative brackets, scrollwork panels, finials, rosettes.

paintable_items.name: Exterior miscellaneous metal item
paintable_items.notes: New ITM for discrete miscellaneous metal items. EA-based — each item. Mailbox posts, light poles, vent covers, access panels, utility boxes. Standard profile complexity assumed unless overridden.

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. METL prefix is unique across all existing task prefixes in the system.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_METL_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based. Examples: TSK_METL_WIRE_BRUSH, TSK_METL_RUST_CONVERT, TSK_METL_PRIME_BRUSH, TSK_METL_FINISH_BRUSH_1, TSK_METL_DEGLOSS_SAND

expected_modules.notes: Protection setup — landscape perimeter, hardscape, siding adjacent, masonry adjacent, light fixtures, roof edge (gutter work)
Condition assessment — existing metal only. Rust extent mapping, adhesion testing, coating thickness measurement. Hard stop if structural rust detected (KD-008).
Mechanical surface prep — wire brushing, power tool cleaning (SSPC-SP2/SP3), scraping, sanding. Intensity is condition-driven (KD-006). NC bare metal gets light scuff only.
Chemical prep — degreasing (all metal), rust conversion (surface rust only, KD-011), solvent wipe for galvanized/aluminum.

Primer application — substrate-type driven primer selection. DTM acrylic (standard steel/iron), DTM alkyd (superior wetting steel/iron), zinc-rich (QT5 critical steel), epoxy (marginal prep), etch/wash (galvanized/aluminum), acrylic bonding (factory-finished). Skipped when SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL or SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY.
First finish coat — DTM acrylic exterior finish (standard topcoat for all metal types).
Intercoat inspection, light sand if needed. Dust removal. QT5 adds raking light inspection.
Second finish coat. Standard at QT3/QT4. QT5 may add third coat on critical areas.
Protection teardown, cleanup, tool cleaning, debris removal

Linear feet of exterior gutter runs
Linear feet of exterior downspout runs
Count of exterior ornamental metal elements
Count of miscellaneous exterior metal items
Metal substrate type (carbon_steel, wrought_iron, aluminum, galvanized). Drives primer selection and material blockers (KD-003, KD-007).
Metal surface condition — maps to substrate state. Drives prep intensity (SSPC level) and rust treatment method (KD-006, KD-011).
Profile complexity (standard, moderate, ornate). Modifier not dimension (KD-005).
Access type per elevation (ground, ladder, scaffold, lift)
Boolean flag — true for NC, false for existing/repaint. Controls condition assessment and prep intensity.
Linear feet of house perimeter where landscape is adjacent and requires protection
Adjacent siding area requiring protection from metal prep/paint overspray
Adjacent masonry area requiring protection from metal prep/paint overspray
Count of exterior light fixtures to mask
Linear feet of roof edge requiring protection during gutter work

quality_tier.notes: QT2 excluded (RC-006) — metal prep complexity exceeds economy scope. QT3 is baseline. QT5 adds zinc-rich primer on critical steel, third coat option, raking light inspection.

application_method.notes: NO roll method — rollers ineffective on metal profiles (RC-005). Brush is primary method (KD-009) for most metal work. Spray for production runs of same-type items. spray_backbrush is PROPOSED addition to controlled_enums — spray followed by brush-back on complex profiles where backroll is impossible. This is functionally distinct from spray_backroll.

sheen.notes: Metal surfaces require higher sheens for corrosion protection and durability. Satin minimum. Semi-gloss is standard. Gloss for QT5 premium and ornamental work.

phase.notes: Combined prime+finish spec. Rust treatment tasks use 'prep' phase. No 'apply' phase — uses 'prime' and 'finish' directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: LF for railing and gutter items. EA for ornamental and misc items. FIXED for condition assessment, tool cleaning, moisture testing. No SF items — metal surfaces are not field-area based.

uom_input.notes: SF used for protection zone inputs (hardscape, siding adjacent, masonry adjacent) even though paintable items are LF/EA.

substrate_state.notes: 5 input states spanning NC and existing. SS_EXT_BARE_METAL = new construction bare. SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY = factory-primed (existing in controlled_enums). SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST = surface corrosion present. SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL = existing sound paint (skip primer). SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT_METAL = cracking/peeling existing paint (full strip+prime). 3 proposed, 1 existing (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY), 1 contextual reuse (SS_EXT_PAINTED_* outputs).

product_role.notes: Specialty for rust converter (not a primer — chemical conversion product). No sealer/clear/stain needed.

protection_level.notes: Exterior zones. Protection level varies by work type — gutter work needs roof edge protection, railing work needs landscape/hardscape protection.

edge_type.notes: Linear for gutter/downspout runs. Complex for ornamental iron junctions.

surface_ids.notes: All 4 primary surface IDs are proposed — new surface vocabulary entries for exterior metal. Adjacent surfaces are existing or proposed in sibling specs.

zone_ids.notes: SF-based siding protection from metal work overspray/debris
SF-based masonry protection from metal work overspray/debris
LF-based roof edge protection during gutter painting

existing_systems_to_consider: SYS_PRIMER_ALUMINUM_DTM — existing DTM etching primer for aluminum windows (SF_WINDOW_INT_NC). Same product class but interior context; exterior metal may share or need separate coverage profiles.
SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM — existing rust-inhibitive DTM primer for steel windows (SF_WINDOW_INT_NC). Same product class; exterior metal may share.
SYS_PRIMER_BONDING — existing bonding primer for smooth/hard substrates (SF_CABINET_NC_PAINT). Could serve factory-finished metal surfaces.

proposed_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Primer for Steel/Iron
proposed_systems.notes: Standard DTM (Direct-to-Metal) acrylic primer. Water-based, flash-rust inhibitive, good adhesion to prepared steel/iron. Quick recoat. Standard choice for QT3/QT4. Reference: SW Pro Industrial DTM Acrylic, BM IronClad.

proposed_systems.name: DTM Alkyd Primer for Steel/Iron
proposed_systems.notes: Alkyd DTM primer — superior surface wetting and rust inhibition vs acrylic. Slower dry, higher VOC, becomes brittle over time. Best for marginal prep situations. QT4/QT5 option when maximum rust inhibition needed.

proposed_systems.name: Zinc-Rich Primer for Critical Steel
proposed_systems.notes: Zinc-rich primer providing galvanic (cathodic) protection. QT5 only — highest corrosion protection tier. Requires SSPC-SP6 minimum surface prep. Must be topcoated (no UV resistance). Typically followed by epoxy intermediate or direct DTM acrylic finish.

proposed_systems.name: Epoxy Primer for Marginal Prep Situations

applies_when.notes: Used as intermediate coat over zinc-rich at QT5, or as primary primer when surface prep is limited

proposed_systems.notes: Two-component epoxy primer — excellent adhesion to marginally prepared surfaces. No UV resistance, must be topcoated within manufacturer window. Pot life limitations. Used in QT5 zinc-rich systems as intermediate coat.

proposed_systems.name: Etch/Wash Primer for Galvanized and Aluminum
proposed_systems.notes: Phosphoric acid etch primer that creates chemical bond on non-ferrous metals. Mandatory on bare galvanized and aluminum (KD-007 material blocker — DTM primers will NOT adhere to these substrates without etch). Thin film, must be topcoated.

proposed_systems.name: Acrylic Bonding Primer for Factory-Finished Surfaces
proposed_systems.notes: Bonding primer for slick factory-finished or factory-primed metal surfaces. Creates adhesion bridge between factory coating and field topcoat. Similar to SYS_PRIMER_BONDING but in exterior metal context with different coverage rates.

proposed_systems.name: DTM Acrylic Exterior Finish for All Metal
proposed_systems.notes: Standard topcoat for ALL exterior metal regardless of substrate type. 100% acrylic DTM formulation — direct adhesion to primed metal, corrosion-inhibitive pigments, UV/weather resistant. QT3 = standard product, QT4 = premium product (SW Pro Industrial Acrolat, BM IronClad), QT5 = premium + additional coat.

proposed_systems.name: Rust Conversion Treatment
proposed_systems.notes: Phosphoric/tannic acid rust converter — chemically converts iron oxide to stable iron phosphate/tannate. Applied after mechanical prep on remaining surface rust. NOT a primer — treatment product. Condition-driven, not dimension-driven (KD-011). Reference: Ospho, Naval Jelly, Loctite Extend.

material_system_prefix.notes: 6 primer systems + 1 finish system + 1 rust conversion product = 8 total material systems. Substrate type is primary primer routing dimension (KD-003). Galvanized/aluminum have material blockers — DTM primers will NOT adhere without etch primer (KD-007). Structural rust = hard stop, not a material system option (KD-008).

proposed_consumables.name: Wire Brush (steel bristle)
proposed_consumables.notes: Hand wire brush for manual rust removal and surface profiling per SSPC-SP2. Steel bristle for ferrous, stainless bristle for non-ferrous (prevent galvanic contamination).

proposed_consumables.name: Wire Wheel Attachment (angle grinder)
proposed_consumables.notes: Power tool wire wheel for SSPC-SP3 power tool cleaning. Aggressive rust and scale removal.

proposed_consumables.name: Flap Disc 80-grit (angle grinder)
proposed_consumables.notes: Flap disc for power tool surface profiling and feathering existing paint edges.

proposed_consumables.name: Angular Sash Brush 2-2.5 inch (metal detail)
proposed_consumables.notes: Angular sash brush for metal detail work — balusters, scrollwork, profiles. Nylon/polyester for water-based DTM products.

proposed_consumables.name: Round Sash Brush 1-1.5 inch (baluster/spindle)
proposed_consumables.notes: Round sash brush for wrapping paint around balusters, spindles, and round profiles.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 411 (metal DTM acrylic)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.011 orifice, 8-inch fan pattern for metal DTM acrylic. Smaller pattern than siding — precision application on narrow metal profiles.

proposed_consumables.name: Airless Spray Tip 313 (detail metal spray)
proposed_consumables.notes: 0.013 orifice, 6-inch fan for detail metal spray — ornamental iron, complex profiles. Tighter pattern for reduced overspray.

proposed_consumables.name: Plastic Sheeting for Exterior Metal Protection
proposed_consumables.notes: 4 mil minimum. Landscape, hardscape, siding/masonry adjacent protection from overspray and rust debris.

proposed_consumables.name: Solvent Wipe Cloth (mineral spirits or acetone)
proposed_consumables.notes: Solvent-dampened wipe for degreasing galvanized/aluminum surfaces and removing mill oil. Pack of cloths or rags.

proposed_consumables.name: Carbide Scraper (failing paint removal)
proposed_consumables.notes: Carbide-tipped scraper for removing failing paint from metal surfaces. More effective than standard putty knife on hard metal substrates.

proposed_configurations.description: 0 primer + 2 finish coats — NC factory-primed metal (SS_EXT_PRIMED_FACTORY)
proposed_configurations.notes: Factory primer accepted as base. Bonding primer optional (included in prime module if needed). 2 DTM acrylic finish coats standard.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 primer + 2 finish coats — bare metal standard (QT3/QT4)
proposed_configurations.notes: Standard 3-round system. Primer type varies by substrate (DTM acrylic for steel/iron, etch/wash for galvanized/aluminum). KD-012 coat system by QT.

proposed_configurations.description: 1 zinc-rich primer + 1 epoxy intermediate + 1 DTM acrylic finish — QT5 premium steel
proposed_configurations.notes: Maximum protection system. Zinc-rich provides galvanic protection, epoxy provides barrier, DTM acrylic provides UV/weather resistance. Each coat serves distinct function.

proposed_configurations.description: Rust treatment + 1 primer + 2 finish coats — existing surface rust (SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST)
proposed_configurations.notes: 4-round system: rust conversion (chemical treatment, not a coat) → DTM primer → 2 finish coats. Rust treatment is condition-driven (KD-011).

proposed_configurations.description: 0 primer + 2 finish coats — existing sound paint (SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL)
proposed_configurations.notes: Existing adhered paint in good condition. Degloss/sand prep, then 2 DTM acrylic finish coats directly over existing coating.

proposed_profiles.description: DTM primer coverage on prepared metal — 400-500 SF/gal on smooth steel, lower on textured/ornamental
Etch/wash primer coverage on galvanized/aluminum — very thin film, 500-600 SF/gal
Zinc-rich primer coverage — 250-350 SF/gal (heavier film required for galvanic protection)
Epoxy primer coverage — 300-400 SF/gal as intermediate coat
DTM acrylic finish coverage on primed metal — 350-450 SF/gal per coat
Rust converter coverage — 200-300 SF/gal depending on rust density

cross_spec_coordination.notes: Metal surfaces are self-contained scope. No cross-spec flags needed. Gutter/downspout work may overlap with soffit spec access/staging but no material or task conflicts. Railing work near porch floors is adjacent but independent scope.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by metal profile complexity
proposed_modifiers.notes: Standard = simple rail/tube/flat sections. Moderate = turned balusters, modest scrollwork. Ornate = complex scrollwork, rosettes, finials (2.0x-3.0x range, 2.5x as midpoint). KD-005: modifier not dimension.

proposed_modifiers.description: Production rate modifier by quality tier for qt_scaled tasks
proposed_modifiers.notes: QT3 baseline. QT4 adds more thorough inspection, careful application. QT5 adds raking light inspection, holiday detection, potential third coat.

materials_json.material_blockers: Galvanized and aluminum substrates BLOCK DTM primers — must use etch/wash primer (KD-007). Implement as compatibility_rule blocker.

sop_modules_json.structural_rust_hard_stop: KD-008: Structural rust (section loss, perforation) is a HARD STOP — not a painting condition. Must be flagged and referred to structural repair. Include as pre-condition check in MOD_METL_ASSESS.

production_json.multi_uom_note: Railing/gutter tasks are LF-based. Ornamental/misc tasks are EA-based. Rates must match UOM of parent item.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: All TSK_ IDs MUST use TSK_METL_ prefix (from this resolution)
RULE 10: All 4 ITM_ IDs MUST be used exactly as registered: ITM_METAL_RAILING (LF), ITM_METAL_GUTTER (LF), ITM_METAL_ORNAMENTAL (EA), ITM_METAL_MISC (EA)
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from this resolution's applicable_enums
RULE 12: Material system routing MUST respect substrate_type blockers — galvanized/aluminum cannot use DTM primers without etch primer (KD-007)
RULE 13: Structural rust (KD-008) MUST trigger hard stop, not a prep pathway

migration_warnings.warning: spray_backbrush is NOT in controlled_enums.json application_method
migration_warnings.action_required: Propose addition of spray_backbrush to controlled_enums.json — spray followed by brush-back on complex metal profiles where roller backwork is impossible. Distinct from spray_backroll (roller-based).
migration_warnings.impact: If rejected, spray_backbrush tasks must be modeled as separate spray + brush tasks in sequence.

migration_warnings.warning: 3 new substrate states proposed for controlled_enums.json
migration_warnings.action_required: Add SS_EXT_BARE_METAL, SS_EXT_SURFACE_RUST, SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT_METAL, SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT_METAL to controlled_enums.json substrate_state valid_values.
migration_warnings.impact: Without these, substrate routing logic cannot distinguish metal-specific conditions.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior Metal Surfaces (Railings, Gutters, Ornamental Iron, Misc Metal)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for exterior metal painting. Covers both NC and existing metal. Distinct from interior metal (SF_WINDOW_INT_NC handles interior window metal). Exterior metal has unique corrosion/weathering concerns, different primer systems, different application methods (no roller), and multi-item/multi-UOM structure.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Acrylic Primer for Steel/Iron
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New system distinct from existing SYS_PRIMER_STEEL_DTM (interior window context). Exterior metal has different coverage rates, environmental exposure, and corrosion inhibition requirements.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Alkyd Primer for Steel/Iron
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Alkyd DTM primer — distinct product class from acrylic DTM. Superior wetting, higher VOC, becomes brittle. QT4/QT5 option.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Zinc-Rich Primer for Critical Steel
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers zinc-rich primers. Unique product class providing galvanic (cathodic) protection. QT5 only.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Epoxy Primer for Marginal Prep / Intermediate Coat
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers epoxy primers. Two-component product with pot life limitations. Used as intermediate in QT5 zinc-rich systems.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Etch/Wash Primer for Galvanized and Aluminum
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers etch primers. Phosphoric acid etch creates chemical bond on non-ferrous metals. Mandatory for galvanized/aluminum (KD-007).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Acrylic Bonding Primer for Factory-Finished Metal
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Similar to existing SYS_PRIMER_BONDING but in exterior metal context with different coverage rates and environmental demands.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Acrylic Exterior Finish for All Metal
registry_additions_proposed.justification: No existing system covers DTM acrylic exterior finish. Standard topcoat for all exterior metal types. Corrosion-inhibitive pigments, UV/weather resistant.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Rust Conversion Treatment Product
registry_additions_proposed.justification: CON_RUST_CONVERTER exists as a consumable but no SYS_ system entry exists for the rust conversion material system. This is a treatment product (not primer), needs system-level tracking for coverage and consumption.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Primer Coverage on Prepared Metal
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Metal-specific coverage profile. 400-500 SF/gal on smooth steel — different from interior window metal or masonry primer.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Etch/Wash Primer Coverage on Galvanized/Aluminum
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Very thin film application — 500-600 SF/gal. Unique coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Zinc-Rich Primer Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Heavy film for galvanic protection — 250-350 SF/gal. No existing coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Epoxy Primer Coverage as Intermediate Coat
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Intermediate coat coverage — 300-400 SF/gal. No existing coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: DTM Acrylic Finish Coverage on Primed Metal
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Metal-specific finish coverage — 350-450 SF/gal per coat. Different substrate porosity from wood/masonry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Rust Converter Coverage
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Rust converter coverage — 200-300 SF/gal depending on rust density. No existing coverage profile.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Metal Profile Complexity Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New factor modifier. Profile complexity is the primary production rate driver for metal work (KD-005). Standard=1.0x, moderate=1.5x, ornate=2.5x.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Metal Quality Tier Modifier
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT-driven rate modifier for qt_scaled tasks. QT3=1.00, QT4=1.25, QT5=1.55.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Bare new metal (uncoated, no rust)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New metal-specific bare state. Distinct from SS_BARE (interior). Exterior bare metal requires immediate corrosion protection. Different primer routing from bare wood or masonry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior metal with surface corrosion (rust present, no structural loss)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Surface-level rust requiring chemical treatment and mechanical removal. Distinct from bare metal and failing paint. Condition-driven prep pathway (KD-006, KD-011).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior metal with sound existing paint (adhered, no rust breakthrough)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Existing paint in good condition on metal substrate. Similar concept to SS_EXT_SOUND_PAINT but metal-specific — requires adhesion testing and degloss, not just cleaning.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Exterior metal with failing existing paint (cracking, peeling, rust breakthrough)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Failing paint on metal with potential rust beneath. Requires full removal to sound substrate, rust treatment if exposed, then full prime+finish system. Distinct from SS_EXT_FAILING_PAINT (generic) because metal failure patterns differ from wood/masonry.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Spray followed by immediate brush-back on complex profiles
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Metal profiles (balusters, scrollwork, ornamental iron) cannot be backrolled — roller cannot reach into complex geometry. spray_backbrush is the metal equivalent of spray_backroll: spray applies product, brush works it into profiles and eliminates runs/drips. Functionally distinct from spray_backroll (roller-based) and spray (no backwork).
